meta.title: dsh-xmm-ai
meta.description: Exposes the models connected by the dsh-connect-* plugins (dsh-connect-workbuddy, dsh-connect-qoder) through an OpenAI-compatible HTTP API at /plugins/dsh-xmm-ai/v1 (GET /v1/models and POST /v1/chat/completions, with streaming). Requests run through the Harness LLM service, reusing the signed-in accounts, credits and model roster. The settings page edits the API keys, default model and remote-access options; a request that omits model or sends "default" uses the configured default model, and changes take effect immediately.
